svg.text: Normal on the smaller center → zero canonical cost
Actual N ⊂ M and core S ⊂ R; no normality of the whole represented algebra is assumed.
A. The actual compatible state gives the full joint balance — 83.9–83.14
φ = φ Eₐ, φ is M-central
φ(ŝ) = τ(μs), μ in L¹(Z(S))₊
βμ = E꜀ᵣ(μ), Cᵣ = Z(R)
kjoint βμ = ℓjoint μ
kjoint = Eᴅ₀(g)/d; ℓjoint = Eᴅ₀(E꜀(g))/d; C = N′ ∩ M.
Both marginals of kjoint are 1; its smaller ℓjoint marginal is also 1.
Smaller marginal → Tμ = μ → μ = βμ → μv = 0, v = d(kjoint − ℓjoint).
B. Conditional Jensen controls the full joint norm — 83.1–83.8
f in L¹(U)₊
β = Pf, P = Eᵥ
Tf = Q(wβ)
Q = Eᵤ
δ = ‖f − Tf‖₁
Qw = Pw = 1
χL(t) = t² for t ≤ L; χL(t) = 2Lt − L² for t > L.
0 ≤ τ(χL(f)) − τ(χL(β)) ≤ τ(χL(f)) − τ(χL(Tf)) ≤ 2Lδ.
‖f − Pf‖₁ ≤ √(2Lδ) + rf(L) + 2rf(L/2); rf(L) = τ(f 1{f > L}).
Uniform integrability: choose one L controlling all tails, then decrease δ.
Exact fixed point: δ = 0; let L → ∞. Thus f = Pf in the full joint algebra.
C. What the additional hypotheses supply — 83.14–83.16
Central normality → φ(b̂) = 0 → positive-cost Følner projections inside A.
Faithful central restriction → v = 0 everywhere; joint normal density matching.
Uniformly integrable normalized projection dimensions + basis stationarity → joint localization.
General relative amenability has not yet supplied either additional hypothesis.
Rectangles and arrow positions are schematic; they encode no dimensions or trace sizes.
Proof locators: 83.3–83.7 (convexity/tails), 83.12–83.14 (actual state), 83.15–83.16 (cost).
Human context: Popa 1994, Sections3.2 and4.2, printed205–206 and211–214. Full proofs retained.
